LINK SAFETY CHECKER

Got a suspicious link or SMS? Check it first.

Paste a web address to look for common warning signs. The check runs entirely in your browser — the link is never opened, sent or stored.

This is a basic warning-sign check, not a guarantee. “No warning signs” never means “safe”. Never share OTPs or PINs, and open banks and government services only by typing the address yourself or using the official app.

HELPLINES & OFFICIAL CHANNELS

Reach the right people, fast

Always verify the address or number before sharing information. Mana Cyber Raksha is not affiliated with the Government of India.

Privacy-first by design

No registration, no database, no analytics and no complaint upload. Checklist ticks and link checks stay inside your browser and are never sent to a server. Only your language choice is remembered on your device. Please avoid typing sensitive personal information anywhere.
